reading.title: Scorpio Sun Under Stationing Lights
overview: The Sun at 20° Scorpio receives squares from Mars and Jupiter in Leo while Mercury retrogrades nearby in the same sign. Venus stations direct in Libra and the Moon moves out of bounds into Capricorn, its detriment. Outer planets show Uranus trine Pluto at under 1° orb, Neptune sextile Pluto, and Uranus sextile Neptune.

Mundane tradition reads the Mars-Jupiter conjunction as expansionist pressure and the Uranus-Pluto trine as structural upheaval. The new moon at 17° Scorpio two days earlier fell in the third house for the United States and the twelfth for Russia, Ukraine and Israel, placing emphasis on communications or hidden matters according to whole-sign houses from each capital.

Stations of Mercury and Venus on 13 November and the Sun’s entry into Sagittarius on 22 November mark the immediate sequence ahead. The Moon’s next aspect is a sextile to Mercury, ending its current separation.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC within 1° while Jupiter opposes the natal Moon. Saturn sextiles natal Uranus. These contacts coincide with reporting on US-Russia talks and Democratic messaging on the Middle East, though the fair-test record finds no reliable link between such transits and event frequency.

Neptune squares the natal Sun and Pluto conjoins natal Saturn. Uranus squares the natal Moon. Current reporting on cyber incidents and Starshield restrictions falls under these degrees, yet the same transits have shown no statistical edge over chance in prior tallies of personnel-loss days.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Jupiter conjoins natal Jupiter and Mercury. Mars squares natal Venus. The twelfth-house new moon placement aligns with coverage of deep strikes and NATO-adjacent waters, without evidence that the configuration improves forecast accuracy.

Saturn squares the natal Sun and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter. Mars squares natal Mars. The Uranus-Pluto trine registers in election-market data at z 5.9, though the broader test record for lunar and Mars triggers remains indistinguishable from chance.

reading.lore_and_intel: Uranus trine Pluto and Mars conjunction Jupiter appear in the supplied overlaps with Taiwan election markets and Ukraine-related reporting at z-values above 4, while Neptune sextile Pluto and Venus sextile Mars touch Middle East and cyber stories. The same aspects show no measurable improvement over baseline rates in the multi-year tests for air-raid alarms, rocket alerts or personnel losses, so the overlaps remain descriptive rather than predictive.

watch.note: Mercury and Venus both station direct; watch for shifts in stalled diplomatic language.
Sun enters Sagittarius; note any change in tone from Scorpio-sector actors.
Full Moon at 2° Gemini; observe whether communications or transport themes intensify.

reading.the_test: Across 1685 to 9778 days of records, Mars afflictions, full moons and eclipses show no better than chance results for Ukraine alarms (+6 % at best, p = 0.11), Israeli alerts, Russian losses or worldwide magnitude-6 quakes. The tests therefore supply no evidence that these configurations forecast the events in question.
